target.title: fix(minimax): apply request policy to media generation requests
target.body:
## Summary
- MiniMax video and music generation now pass `models.providers.<providerId>.request` into provider HTTP resolution instead of silently ignoring configured request overrides.
- Removes the caller-level hard-coded `allowPrivateNetwork: false` so configured request policy can control private-network access while the default remains deny-by-default when no request override is configured.
- collision check: searched `minimax request policy`, `minimax allowPrivateNetwork`, and `minimax video proxy`; no same-file or same-problem open PR was found for these MiniMax media generation paths.

## Verification
- `TMPDIR=/media/vdc/0668001470/tmp/openclaw-task-tmp node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/minimax/video-generation-provider.test.ts extensions/minimax/music-generation-provider.test.ts` - passed; `Test Files  2 passed (2)`, `Tests  19 passed (19)`.
- `TMPDIR=/media/vdc/0668001470/tmp/openclaw-task-tmp node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.extensions.json extensions/minimax/video-generation-provider.ts extensions/minimax/video-generation-provider.test.ts extensions/minimax/music-generation-provider.ts extensions/minimax/music-generation-provider.test.ts extensions/minimax/provider-http.test-helpers.ts` - passed; exit 0.
- `git diff --check` - passed; exit 0.
- mutation check: temporarily removing the video and music `request:` parameters made the focused Vitest fail with `expected undefined to deeply equal { allowPrivateNetwork: true, headers: ... }` in both portal media tests; restoring the patch returned the test to green.

## Real behavior proof

Behavior addressed: MiniMax video and music generation HTTP requests now honor configured provider request overrides such as custom headers and `allowPrivateNetwork` for the active provider id.

Real environment tested: local Linux Node source checkout; focused Vitest drives the real exported MiniMax video and music provider builders with `minimax-portal` config containing provider request overrides, while the outbound HTTP helper is mocked at the provider HTTP boundary.

Exact steps or command run after this patch: `TMPDIR=/media/vdc/0668001470/tmp/openclaw-task-tmp node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/minimax/video-generation-provider.test.ts extensions/minimax/music-generation-provider.test.ts`

Evidence after fix: the portal video and music tests assert `resolveProviderHttpRequestConfig` receives the configured request object, the final POST receives `allowPrivateNetwork: true`, and the configured request header is present on the outbound request headers for both media paths.

Observed result after fix: `Test Files  2 passed (2)` and `Tests  19 passed (19)`.

What was not tested: no live MiniMax endpoint was called; the proof validates OpenClaw's MiniMax request-policy plumbing locally without sending third-party network traffic.
